lines.en: Another unexciting day winds down as two young creatures begin to contemplate finding their way back to their burrows.
And while they’re silently thankful to have made it to sundown without their necks being torn open, it’s been unmistakably dull on the plains as of late. And they’re not sure how to feel.
Without the looming threat of predation, they’ve spent their time chewing on grass and picking bugs out of the dirt.
They have so much space to run, but nothing to run from. So why does that make them feel incomplete?

One creature stares outside and ponders whether or not the act of being chased is what excited her at all to begin with. And if these days are only boring now since her legs have begun to atrophy from lack of use.
The other creature’s thoughts are more complicated and conflicted, but we’ll get to them in a moment.
: Hah...
For now, we’ll zero in on Chika Chosokabe — a gyaru turned bad-girl who would not hesitate to take up the role of predator if the plains stay dull for far too long.
Which isn’t to say she has anything against the other prey. It’s just that these seasons of unintended hibernation can cause things to get a little out of control every now and again.
As the eldest of the pack, the responsibility to reestablish control would likely fall on her. And she’s loved and feared enough that the others would be sure to follow.
: Rin, question.
: How often do you think about jumping off a bridge?
But the leader of a pack must not be chosen based on age and status alone. Because, in this case, it’s the eldest who’s grown the most weary.
You see, this creature spends the bulk of its time foraging for berries, just to split them with lesser creatures upon returning to the burrow.
She grows weaker and more tired by the day now that she does not need to remain alert at all times.
When her eyes close at night, she feels less inclined to keep them open to see what happens next.
And when the wind rushes into the hole in which she sleeps, she silently wishes for it to carry her away.
: Uhh...
But it won’t.
If she’s ever going to go anywhere, she needs to be the one to take the first step.
No wind, nor nature in any form will rescue her from the complete absence of motivation.
And as she emerges from her hole and gazes at her reflection in the lake, it becomes clear that she must either drink from these waters for the rest of her life-
: Probably...not as much as you’d think?
Or drown herself in them.
: Fuck.
For this field is actually a farm.
: Is that...something you’re thinking about doing?
And the only ones who can move in and out are those big enough to hop the fence.
: Maybe.
: But, like...not a big bridge. Maybe a small one. With some water below it that, like, wouldn’t definitely kill me if I fell in. But could. You know?
: No.
: Sorry. I’m just being dramatic. You don’t need to put me on suicide watch or anything.
: That’s good, because I have no idea how I would even do that. And I’m pretty sure people wouldn’t actually take me seriously when I say it’s “for a friend.”
: Would you mind if I ranted about personal stuff for a few minutes? Because Yumi sucks at listening and it’s not like I can get my sister involved in any of my problems.
: You can rant as much as you want. I just have no idea how useful I’m going to be since I kind of suck at dealing with...almost everything, now that I think about it.
: It’s about boys. Is that okay?
: Chika...I’m not allergic to boys. I’m bisexual. Why would that not be okay?
: Because romance can be an annoying, touchy subject and you’re still getting over a breakup.
: With...a girl.
: Otoha is a girl, Chika. There was no penis there. I checked.
: I meant “boys” as a concept! Not literal boys, Rin! Just pretend I said “romance” instead!
: Fine, yeah. But again, dealing with that kind of stuff isn’t exactly my forte. Especially now that 100%% of my relationships have ended in complete and utter failure.
: No they haven’t. Otoha was never good enough for you anyway. And, if I were you, I’d see this as a good opportunity to get back out there and try again with someone who deserves your time.
: But anyway...if you haven’t already guessed, this is about Sensei and me.
: Whaaaaaaaaaaaat?
: You’re a bad actor.
: I’m a bad everything but that’s never stopped me before.
: I like that. Your...perseverance is one of my favorite qualities about you.
: Liar. If that were true, you’d have been immediately impressed by my confession and we would have made out on the beach and wouldn’t even be talking about Sensei right now.
: Fair. But still, it’s cool that you can just...keep going the way you have been.
: Sensei and I aren’t even broken up and I feel like my whole life is being torn apart. I can’t even imagine how I’d be if we ended things.
: Are you...actually thinking about ending things?
: I’m not! But between the last couple months and just...the first few interactions he’s had since rejoining the world, it feels like he’s pushing me away.
: Like, he came over to babysit the other day and was totally gone by the time I came back. He didn’t even tell me he was leaving. I could have, like...called Yumi or something if I knew.
: Well...I mean...
: Uhh...
: “Uhh” what? Give it to me straight. I can’t afford to beat around the bush at a time like this. My relationship is potentially on the line here.
: I just mean...don’t you maybe think asking him to babysit in his current condition is kind of...not a great idea?
: What do you mean?
: I mean...you remember what he said, right? About losing something?
: Sensei’s kind of like...miserable right now. And he’s gone through patches like that in the past, sure. But this is way worse than I’ve ever seen. And I doubt I’d want to babysit in that condition.
: Aaaaaaaaah fuck. Yup. I’m an idiot. I was so excited to have him back that I didn’t even think of that. It’s no wonder he just up and left. I would’ve done the same thing.
: Oh. Oh, okay. That was easy then. Is the rant over?
: No. I don’t get very many opportunities to do this, so I need to make sure I get everything off my chest. But you’ll be allowed to rant back to me once I’m done. It’s only fair.
: Can I...postpone my half of the rant session? I have work today.
: I’ll allow it. Now, please brace yourself as I am about to talk about sex.
: Ah!
: You dropped your guitar.
: No I didn’t.
: I told you to brace yourself.
: Yeah, but there wasn’t a big enough gap between that and the sex word. You have to let me brace myself before you tell me to brace myself. Don’t you understand how my brain works by now?
: I’ll do a better job in the future, I promise.
: Then...what do you want to say about...the designated topic of sexual intercourse? Which is a topic you have decided to discuss. Not me.
: Should I or should I not press him for sex?
: I’m...pretty sure it’s the boy who presses the girl for the mating press, right?
: Rin, no!
: No? Hold on. I have to Google this.
: No, I meant like...press him in general!
: Huh? Are you seriously that horny that you can’t wait until he doesn’t feel like he’s dying anymore to have him do you?
: That’s not...the entire reason. It’s more like...
: I know Sensei uses sex to make himself feel better rather than talking things out. But when I tried the other day, he didn’t want to.
: And I’m not sure if I should try again because I’m not sure if it was, like...just a bad time or if he doesn’t want to have sex at all for a little while.
: And it’s fine either way, I just don’t know how to make him feel better and...
: And yes, I am also very horny.
: Well, as someone who has never had sex with Sensei, I do not think I can properly instruct you when it is and is not a good time to try and do that with, to, or on him.
: Figures.
: I guess I should wait for a better time to ask about the threesome then.
: A better time to ask about the what?
: Threesome. You, me, and Sensei.
: Like...going to the movies?
: Sure.
: Because for a second-
: And then having sex with each other.
: Ngh!
: You dropped your guitar again.
: You didn’t even tell me to brace myself that time! And what’s this about a three-
: Shh. Keep your voice down.
: What is this about a threesome? Why me? Why now?
: The short version is that I wanted to do something special for Sensei and that I told him I’d be open to a threesome with him and a girl of his choosing.
: So who backed down and why am I the replacement for them?
: Rin. He chose you, dummy.
: Me?! Why?
: A bunch of reasons, probably. You two are close...you swing both ways...and you had a crush on me for a million years, so he probably wants to see the chemistry.
: But I guess there’s no point in trying to arrange this now if I have no idea when he’ll even want to do it again.
: And you...you’re okay with this? With me?
: Hm? Of course. Why wouldn’t I be? I’d have probably chosen you as well if he let me pick.
: Oh my God. I should have known this was a dream the moment you said the word “sex.”
: You realize you’re going to make me blush too if you keep blushing like that, right?
: You’re already blushing! And this is your fault! I just wanted to play guitar!
: Okay but, in my defense, it’s been over two months since I’ve done anything and I can’t even walk down the produce aisle without getting hot at this point.
: What kind of fetish is that?!
: Are you in or out? Whenever things start moving again, I mean. Just give me a yes or no answer. We don’t need to spend any more time on it than that.
: Chika...
: I need to...think about this...
: There is...literally no denying that this is a dream come true in many ways, but...I...
: It’s fine. Just...we can drop it for now and get back to it later. You’re still freshly broken-up with, so I can see why you’d want to maybe-
: Mutually freshly-broken up with.
: Yeah. That.
: Anyway, we can talk about it later.
: For now, I guess I just need to...figure out the next steps when it comes to handling this whole relationship thing.
: We’ve got into little fights and stuff before. And all of them were because of things I was doing wrong, so...
: I’m sure this is all going to blow over and that I’ll...have more mistakes to learn from when it does.
: Are you sure you should be looking at them as mistakes at all, though? Because you’re like...the one person I can’t imagine tripping up when it comes to relationship stuff.
: You’re nothing like me when it comes to that. Your head’s so firmly on your shoulders at all times that I often think you’re just a really hot, fleshy mannequin.
: I think making little mistakes is pretty unavoidable when it comes to relationships. I’m just not really sure how to handle or...even accept that I might not be able to help this time.
: And that sucks. It really sucks. Like...you know things are bad when Ami is able to help and I’m not.
: Hey. Unrelated note — just out of curiosity, if I ever needed help burying a body, could I rely on you?
: I’m...not going to bat for Ami when it comes to all that weird shit she said in class the other day. But I don’t think murdering her is the answer.
: Murder? Ami? That thought never even occurred to me.
: She needs help, Chika. Like...serious help.
: But she’s so stable and normal.
: I get that she rubbed you the wrong way. She rubbed all of us the wrong way. But I think some of us might be taking things a little too hard on her right now.
: Especially since she’s not even here to defend herself.
: To be fair, I’m not really sure there’s anything she could say that would help her defend herself. Not from me, at least. Especially not when she’s going to try to blackmail me with my own nudes.
: Yeah...I had a feeling that’s what she showed you.
: Whatever. At least now she knows I’m fucking her uncle and I don’t have to dance around it anymore. If she wants to use that against me, whatever. I know she’s not going to expose Sensei, though.
: I thought more about it and she’d gain literally nothing from him being arrested, so at least I’ve got peace of mind in knowing he’ll be okay.
: You’re thinking too much about him and not enough about yourself...
: It’s like...
: With Otoha and me...it’s pretty clear in hindsight that I was asking for way more than what she was willing to give. And I love Sensei...but I don’t want you to fall into that same trap with him.
: Hm.
: I guess that’s how it would look to you.
: We’ve kept our situation pretty confidential because of the impact it could have on him, so it’s probably tough to see how much he really loves me from the outside.
: He’s nothing like Otoha, though. She was straight up evil and I still can’t believe the way she treated you.
: You’re making her out to be way worse than she actually was, Chika. She just...
: She didn’t love me.
: But she said she did. And that’s unforgivable.
: Okay! Rant over. I feel way better now.
: Did it accomplish anything? No. Am I still just as lost and screwed as I was ten minutes ago? Yes!
: But at least I got to talk to somebody who will actually listen.
: Yumi listens too. She’s just scary.
: You only think she’s scary because you don’t know her.
: And because I watched her beat Nodoka halfway to death. Even if that’s something we’ve all kind of wanted to do at times.
: Fair enough. What’s the plan now, though? Still going to work? Or would you rather come over and see my cool, new apartment?
: Definitely the apartment. But I’m trying to get promoted, so I don’t think skipping work is a thing I should be doing right now.
: Offer’s still there whenever you’re free. And if you bring a peanut-free snack, you can immediately gain the undying affection of my little sister who will one day be the prime minister of Japan.
: It’ll be good to have her on your side for when the next space war starts.
: I’ll keep that in mind for my next day off. But for now, I must get dressed!
: Need any help?
: Need? No. Want? Yes. Will accept? No again. Bye!
: Hahah! Later, Rin.
: Thanks for listening to me complain! I’ll be sure to keep you updated on my sex life and the status of my relationship with someone I shall not name within these walls!
: You don’t have to do that, but thank you!
And so our segment focusing on Chika Chosokabe comes to an end-
